title: Start a New Business
seoTitle: Start a New Business | Nava Wilson Professional Corporation

items.html: When embarking on a new business venture, it’s crucial to thoughtfully assess the most suitable business structure. The chosen structure has lasting effects on owners and operators, influencing aspects like personal liability and tax obligations. Consulting with an experienced business lawyer is essential to identify the optimal structure for each unique situation.

items.title: What legal steps are essential when starting a new business in Toronto, Ontario?
items.html: Critical legal steps include choosing a business structure, registering the business, obtaining necessary permits and licenses, and drafting contracts. Consulting with a corporate lawyer is recommended to ensure compliance.

items.title: What type of business structure is most suitable for my new venture, and how do I choose?
items.html: The choice of business structure (sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation, etc.) depends on factors like liability, tax implications, and business goals. Seeking advice from a business lawyer helps determine the optimal structure for your specific needs.

items.title: How do I protect my business name and brand legally?
items.html: To safeguard your business name and brand, consider registering trademarks. A business lawyer can guide you through the registration process and provide advice on intellectual property protection.

items.title: Are there specific regulations and permits I need to be aware of when starting a business in Toronto?
items.html: Yes, various regulations and permits apply, depending on your industry. A business lawyer can help identify and obtain the necessary permits and ensure compliance with local, provincial, and federal regulations
